main_body: Steel safe body, about 14px wide and 22px tall, with an inset door panel, a gold dial and a handle on the front
top_band: light grey, rows 10-12, plus a lighter front-edge line at row 13; only about 3 rows, very thin for the body
evidence: Down the middle column: light grey rows 10-12, a pale edge line at row 13, then the front face from row 14 to about row 30. The face holds a dark inset door frame and a dial. The top is only 3 rows of a 22-row object and its tone is close to the front face, so it reads as a cap or rim on a front-facing elevation rather than a clear horizontal surface. There is no clear eave shadow under the edge. When in doubt, fail.

style.evidence: The grey body has about 3-4 steps. The outline is a dark slate that is almost neutral, close to a uniform sticker line. The front panel and the top have large flat fills with no grain, speckle or per-material variation. Tiles carry about 3-5 colours, far below the stall and well references, which have rich texture and many tones.
